statement: Offering the best in on-leash walks right in your neighborhood, and loving in-home pet care.
body:
## Monday Through Friday Mid-Day Dog Walks

This service is for those pets that need a little TLC, fresh air and time to stretch their legs during the work week.

Walks are typically **45** minutes in duration and can vary from 1 to 5 times per week depending upon the owners work schedule and the dogs needs.

Free daily updates available via text message or email.

## All Services Include

* Private and personalized dog walks for up to 2 dogs in the same household
* Your dog(s) will be walked on-leash around its own neighborhood to ensure its safety and comfort
* Reinforced training (if applicable)
* Fresh water & treats
* Food refill & brushing (upon request)
* We provide poop bags and discard of all waste
* Photo updates of your furry family!
* And of course, tons of love, attention and playtime!

*Please Note: Pawblem Solved does not offer boarding, day care, overnight stays or group park visits.*
footnote: *Please inquire for sitting services regarding any other type of pet or additional visiting times.*
